website.error: Not pursued — issuer is a medical device company (3D ECG / cardiac monitoring), no drug pipeline page applicable.

ctgov.note: No P1-P3 sponsored interventional drug trials (device company).

commercial_product.modality: Credit-card-sized cable-free ambulatory 3D ECG device that synthesizes a 12-lead ECG via a personalized transformation matrix; physician portal and cloud-based algorithms
regulatory: FDA 510(k) clearance — 3D ECG recording device for arrhythmia assessment (December 2024)
FDA 510(k) clearance — 12-Lead ECG synthesis software for arrhythmia assessment (December 2025)
device_studies_in_progress: ALIGN-ACS pilot study — 100-patient ED chest pain study comparing HeartBeam device to standard 12-lead ECG; first patients enrolled March 2026; designed to support future FDA indication expansion for heart attack assessment
Extended Wear Patch (12L patch) — working prototype; pre-pivotal device development
Strategic AI collaboration with Mount Sinai (Icahn School of Medicine) for cardiac AI development
commercial_product.first_commercial_customer: ClearCardio (announced March 4, 2026) — preventive cardiology practice; staged rollout under Letter of Intent

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medical device company — sole product is the FDA 510(k)-cleared HeartBeam System (cable-free ambulatory 3D ECG). No proprietary drug pipeline. The active ALIGN-ACS study is a 100-patient device pilot in support of a future 510(k) indication expansion (heart attack assessment), not a P1/P2/P3 drug trial. 10-K notes substantial doubt regarding going concern.
